messages.text: Wondering if you have any cancellations on the magic miner 4t that could ship sooner than november?

Short answer, no. Cancelled units don't get reallocated, they just go back into the batch and it ships in order, so there's no queue jumping. Every open Magic Miner 40T order ships November 14.

If you already have one on order, give me the order number and the name or postcode ····I'll confirm yours. If you're still deciding and need something this month, we do have smaller units in stock now, though they cost more per terahash than the 40T. Which is it?
